architecture_boundary.axiomarc_role: Canonical state, identity, lineage, lifecycle, validity, persistence intent, and reuse control
architecture_boundary.execution_role: External systems remain responsible for retrieval, generation, evaluation, and other execution work

evidence_policy.MEASURED: Directly observed in the frozen validation workload.
evidence_policy.DERIVED: Calculated from measured values or validated identity/lifecycle rules.
evidence_policy.PROJECTED: Scaled scenario output; not a new physical run.
evidence_policy.REFERENCE: Measured value carried from a separate controlled persistence/reconstruction reference cell.
evidence_policy.NOT_CLAIMED: A metric the showcase deliberately does not infer.

source_recurrence_characterization.scope: Controlled source-recurrence characterization; not a customer-population estimate

not_claimed: Logical reusable exact-KV footprint equals physical VRAM returned to the allocator.
GPU seconds or joules saved can be inferred from generation-call avoidance alone.
The public Space is a new live retrieval/generation/evaluation benchmark run.
Projected workload volumes are new physical measurements.
Controlled source-recurrence profiles represent a typical customer population.
The public showcase contains or exposes the proprietary production AxiomARC runtime.
